items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I was up there about a month ago with Ray Bryant playing at Loulu's.

ctx.x: I go to Syracuse a couple times a year with, you know, as a guest. I go up there as -- in fact, I've been up to Syracuse -- I first went up there with Ray Bryant, and then I went up there with Red Richards, and I went up there with my own group. And I've gone up there as a guest to play with a group up there at the Dinklers.
And then I just came back from Boston. I was up there about a month ago with Ray Bryant playing at Loulu's.
